nodes.rationale: pdftotext-layout can emit real numbers under wrong predator columns. pdfgrid groups word bboxes with PyMuPDF preferred/Poppler fallback and renders ragged mistakes visibly.

nodes.label: Header anchors and merge_gap tuning
nodes.rationale: Run raw first; numeric header anchors preserve sparse/empty columns. Left/center/right agreement handles labels versus aligned digits. merge_gap~0.4 for tight diets avoids numeric fusion;~2 for typical tables.

nodes.label: Rotated working copies and rendered verification
nodes.rationale: Keep original; rotate working copy and verify orientation. Compare flagged numbers to >=200dpi source render, not another extraction; scans/manual/OCR method explicit. Empty cell remains distinct from0.
nodes.norm_label: rotated working copies and rendered verification

nodes.label: Caption and footnote mandatory follow-up
nodes.rationale: Resolve see-text pointers before extracting affected cells; parentheses/assumed/adjusted/inherited references alter provenance. Unresolved pointer is reported missing evidence, not filled.

nodes.label: Whole-chapter and targeted prose sweep
nodes.rationale: prose_sweep reports candidate passages, not automatic values. Read each in context, include discussion and re-search remaining blanks by group. Pointer hits persist even numbers-only.

nodes.label: Scoped prose numeric derivation
nodes.rationale: Identify groups, rate versus amount, measurement versus assumption and override. Assimilation complement, discard-of-catch versus discard-of-landings and model area arithmetic recorded. Entirely→1, qualitative mainly is not a numeric diet; partial proportions leave missing remainder.

nodes.label: Source table versus prose conflict hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Prefer structured table except footnote redirects cell; methods for assumptions and explicit later-specific revision. Retain both exact locators and choice, never average or choose better balance.
nodes.norm_label: source table versus prose conflict hierarchy

nodes.label: Figure-derived limited precision
nodes.rationale: Use300dpi gridlines, no eye log-axis extrapolation, only one/two supported significant figures, sign and slope endpoints. Unreadable figure stays blank.

nodes.label: Purpose-specific published-field CSV companions
nodes.rationale: Fixed eight imports retain Z/PQ existing fields; extra stanzas/migration/fleet/scenario/vulnerability/provenance in companions with units/status/locators and SHA manifest. Time-series distinct from model-period values, ordinary quoted CSV allowed.

nodes.label: Companion canonical retention and missing-mask reconstruction
nodes.rationale: published_companions rows retained/reconstructed with manifest and SOURCE_FIDELITY_CHECK after reopening. Rectangular unique headers or verbatim source_grid, safe filenames; manual changed omitted file prevents cleanup. Numeric and missing-mask tolerance absolute1e-12/relative1e-14, parameter_roles distinguish estimated inputs.
nodes.norm_label: companion canonical retention and missing-mask reconstruction

nodes.label: Known habitat and BA basis conversion
nodes.rationale: Whole-model metadata only source-supported; missing habitat fraction cannot become1. Preserve BA form/literal, scale only supported habitat absolute values; whole_model_area flag prevents double scaling. Known fleet subtotals don't complete removals.
nodes.norm_label: known habitat and ba basis conversion

nodes.label: Explicit reported-landings export scope
nodes.rationale: Default export requires both known landings/discards. Explicit reported_landings convention retains limited basis with export_scope while total unknown remains unknown. Evidence companions have no automatic calculator effect.

nodes.label: Multi-format distinct-model source inventory
nodes.rationale: Record file/role/model area-period-version/content/authority before rows. One paper can contain separate parameterizations with own directory/provenance; verify group order for each. PDFs pages, spreadsheet hidden sheets/formulas, DOCX footnotes, code-derived values and OCR methods recorded.

nodes.label: Source authority investigation hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Machine-readable author data, final table, prose, figure, prior calculation guide investigation without discarding conflicts. Preserve both/choice and search entire assigned bundle before declaring absent; no averaging/normalizing.

nodes.label: Scientific source role versus catalog presence
nodes.rationale: Paper manifests/role index record bytes/context; native inputs provenance numerical use; portable source_paths only relocation. Unknown bibliography/access stays unknown. Independent catch/TL/NPP need no Ecopath selection/extraction and unfinished separately owned research requires inclusion authorization.
nodes.norm_label: scientific source role versus catalog presence

nodes.label: Caption-first native header and row crosswalk
nodes.rationale: Write header→EwE interpretation before numbers; verify relationship/independent row and join exact identities rather than positions. Count blocks/consumers and flag unresolved columns.
nodes.norm_label: caption-first native header and row crosswalk

nodes.label: Printed cell notation and status
nodes.rationale: Estimated parentheses/footnotes, source0, missing dash, censored inequality/trace and diet blank remain distinct. Read caption before interpreting, never silently zero trace or infer numeric values.

nodes.label: Source-supported area currency and rate conversions
nodes.rationale: Absolute area and daily rates use explicit source factors; wet/dry/carbon only source-supported conversion, seasonal ambiguity remains. Record applied factor because converted output is not literal source.
nodes.norm_label: source-supported area currency and rate conversions

nodes.label: Continued split transposed and stacked tables
nodes.rationale: Join continued blocks by prey labels and independent counts, numeric-row header anchors, stage/mean subcolumns explicit, merge wrapped labels, aggregate rows not groups. Rotated pages use supported working-copy workflow.
nodes.norm_label: continued split transposed and stacked tables

nodes.label: numpy >=1.24
nodes.rationale: Declared minimum extraction dependency; requirement listing does not certify installed availability.

nodes.label: openpyxl >=3.1
nodes.rationale: Declared minimum extraction dependency; requirement listing does not certify installed availability.

nodes.label: pandas >=2.0
nodes.rationale: Declared minimum extraction dependency; requirement listing does not certify installed availability.

nodes.label: PyMuPDF >=1.24
nodes.rationale: Declared minimum extraction dependency; requirement listing does not certify installed availability.

nodes.label: Active mapping resource and regional overrides
nodes.rationale: Resource belongs active paper-to-PPR skill, not third skill. Current regional/validation contract controls confidence and adoption. Former mapper selection workbook/top10/work-order/builder and95% target are obsolete.
nodes.norm_label: active mapping resource and regional overrides

nodes.label: Selected regional model exact inventory
nodes.rationale: Maintained workbook reader and registry.resolve_model identify Overview/Groups/catch. Literal IDs/punctuation/taxon_descr faithful. Evidenced mapping possible under NOT_RUN, while missing inventory leaves assignment pending.

nodes.label: Source species-to-group membership transcription
nodes.rationale: Inspect all axes, source definitions/boundaries/synonyms/adopted predecessors. Diet list can be illustrative; every composite candidate reconciled. Actual supplement recovery attempts/date/result recorded; citation is not reading.

nodes.label: No automatic allocation fallback
nodes.rationale: Select evidence-backed candidates independently of coefficients. Direct caught mass then reviewed complete catch/biomass Medium, W11 explicitly Very low. No automatic equal split, normalization of bad sums or silent zero candidate removal; nearby donor confidence/SPPR don't copy.

nodes.label: Mapping coverage and numerical availability separation
nodes.rationale: Persist exact full-precision weighted rows; unresolved group/weight blank. Validate all taxa, duplicates/composites/nonnegative unit sums/basal errors/source contradictions and actual tonnage support. Structural success doesn't certify source/model approval; examples aren't assignment tables.
nodes.norm_label: mapping coverage and numerical availability separation

nodes.label: Earlier coarse-taxon coverage examples
nodes.rationale: Earlier unresolved snapshots Arabian21.8%, Bay22.3%, East China22.1% motivate attention to tonnage. These counts are historical, not current mapping readiness.

nodes.label: Coarse label candidate containment heuristics
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy/SAU habitat-size/commercial hints and model members constrain each plausible group, including dedicated plus residual compartments. Playbook's hard habitat/offshore exclusions are narrowed by current M10/M11 regional contract, not cross-region lookup tables.

nodes.label: Superseded coarse mapper automatic weight cascade
nodes.rationale: Retained playbook describes blank catch composition and automatic model-catch→biomass→equal with three-level confidence. Current regional/mapping/output contract overrides this: full numeric reviewed weights, Medium proxy assumptions, explicit W11 and five confidence levels; no automatic fallback.
nodes.norm_label: superseded coarse mapper automatic weight cascade

nodes.label: TL corroboration without guild selection
nodes.rationale: TL alone cannot assign guild; arbitrary broad group mixture just approximates average SPPR. Don't split a known single home merely to hide uncertainty.

nodes.label: Model group taxonomy guild habitat stage and strata axes
nodes.rationale: Neighbour seas can have incompatible axes. Record actual source prefixes, stocks/pools/catchability and model-versus-target area before mapping; inherited examples remain examples.
nodes.norm_label: model group taxonomy guild habitat stage and strata axes

nodes.label: Taxonomic pool versus single stock
nodes.rationale: Dedicated names can hide restricted pool; source definitions and independent evidence govern, not generic name or catch share alone.

nodes.label: Feeding-guild model membership evidence
nodes.rationale: Retrieve source list/supplement and diet context; families may span dedicated and guild groups. Diet corroborates feeding, not exhaustive membership under current contract; TL alone cannot choose guild.

nodes.label: Spatial stratum allocation distinction
nodes.rationale: Bay numeric prefixes denote subareas/depth versus unprefixed whole domain; native example warns against all catch silently placed stratum2. Biomass/stage catch examples require current evidence hierarchy, not automatic assignment.

nodes.label: Nonliving and primary producer mapping restrictions
nodes.rationale: Detritus/import/PP catch assignment usually invalid, documented harvested seaweed exception. Verify actual fishery for plankton/benthic small groups; meaningful current analogues require explicit rationale, not default observed catch claim.
nodes.norm_label: nonliving and primary producer mapping restrictions

nodes.label: Adopted Matching authority
nodes.rationale: PPR Matching is the adopted mapping registry; transcriptions/proposals remain evidence until authorized, with one exact model-region decision set.

nodes.label: Exact mapping weights and unresolved rows
nodes.rationale: Preserve persisted precision/identities, nonnegative resolved weight sums and blank unresolved fields; do not normalize erroneous sums or invent automatic fallback.
nodes.norm_label: exact mapping weights and unresolved rows

nodes.label: Separate mapping confidence and assumptions
nodes.rationale: Overall confidence is the weaker necessary membership/allocation component; direct composition and assumed proxies retain distinct confidence/provenance.

nodes.label: Purpose-specific membership transcription
nodes.rationale: Printed and verified accepted names remain separate and table purpose/exhaustiveness govern membership; absence from examples does not prove exclusion.

nodes.label: Complete accepted group dictionary
nodes.rationale: Retain unfished and nonliving groups, grouping axes, source relationships and precise locators; documented search completion differs from missing evidence.

nodes.label: Checkable mapping explanation and source identity
nodes.rationale: Decisive source-located facts, applicability and exact keys distinguish publication membership from analyst inference; filenames alone cannot establish area.
nodes.norm_label: checkable mapping explanation and source identity

nodes.label: ModelData
nodes.rationale: Loads supported Ecopath JSON and exposes source tables, diet, detritus fate and explicit discard-return flows with coverage metadata. Integer-registry datasets are unavailable in this checkout; missing identity stays missing.

nodes.label: PPRCalculator
nodes.rationale: Constructs from canonical model, ModelData or existing dictionary. Deterministic defaults and optional per-group LIM produce a runtime state; completion and separate balanced_model copy do not establish scientific validity.

nodes.label: Specific Primary Production Required
nodes.rationale: Basal production per unit of group production; fishery PPR sums catch times group coefficient.

nodes.label: Regular PP DET and Import groups
nodes.rationale: Consumers, autotrophs, recycling pools and external diet are distinct roles. The loader injects synthetic diet_import.
nodes.norm_label: regular pp det and import groups

nodes.label: Diet composition and detritus fate
nodes.rationale: Diet describes feeding; separate group-to-pool fractions route waste and dead biomass. Standalone fate and explicit zeros are preserved; unknown fractions are not observations.

nodes.label: Internal fishery discard returns
nodes.rationale: Source-backed absolute donor-to-pool flows enter receiving detritus once with donor SPPR, separate from mortality and egestion. Subtract only returned material from external catch for balance; source fishery catch remains unchanged.

nodes.label: Transfer efficiency choices
nodes.rationale: GE uses P/Q; TE multiplies gross and ecotrophic efficiencies; With Egestion uses assimilated intake; global uses scalar or consumer-weighted arithmetic mean. TE-zero consumers remain included and zero consumer catch falls back to biomass weights.

nodes.label: Diet-derived trophic level
nodes.rationale: TL=(I-DC)^-1 times one; cycle removal, basal-detritus choice and detritus-row treatment determine the convention.

nodes.label: Catch-weighted PPR and source scopes
nodes.rationale: get_PPR returns one row. only_inner drops Import columns; only_pp also drops DET. An aggregated Series cannot recover source breakdown.

nodes.label: Coupled detritus recycling
nodes.rationale: GE and With Egestion solve (I-B)x=c. Separate-pool, pooled and open-system choices are distinct assumptions; finite output is not validation.

nodes.label: Symbolic imported-diet accounting
nodes.rationale: as_DC retains a diet-derived imported cost and equations for a supported import-aware budget; as_PP fixes import at one. sppr_det_value can replace solved detritus scaling.

nodes.label: Gamma TE Monte Carlo
nodes.rationale: Positive TEs are gamma-sampled and clipped; nonpositive values are pinned. Negative coefficients are rejected, optional divergence screening reuses the solve, and samples/rejection diagnostics retain uncertainty assumptions.

nodes.label: Formulation-specific SPPR budget
nodes.rationale: Outflow includes external catch after internal returns, accumulation, migration, floor sink and formulation-specific unrouted export. GE values donor mortality, With Egestion also values complete-diet egestion, and TE counts basal mortality because consumer mortality is in efficiency.

nodes.label: Configuration-specific diagnostic verdict
nodes.rationale: Input, living/detritus convergence and PP budget are graded; overall is worst component and footprint ungraded. TE with explicit returns uses the actual coupled recycling matrix. Configuration and matrices belong to one execution.

nodes.label: Scientific engine API scope
nodes.rationale: Examples are background, not regional adoption. Actual audited settings and authorized units/exact pairs govern; compatible saved methods and draws remain preserved.

nodes.label: Model loading and runtime transformation guide
nodes.norm_label: model loading and runtime transformation guide

nodes.label: Extracted model values versus calculation model
nodes.rationale: Canonical JSON retains extracted values, accepted transformations and missingness; loading can transform further. Input hash, executed code and recorded settings identify results. Source, completed pre-floor and effective states are separate.
nodes.norm_label: extracted model values versus calculation model

nodes.label: Exporter and bare-constructor defaults
nodes.rationale: Exporter enables underdetermined completion and normalization and leaves living BA for solving; bare defaults differ. Defaults and tolerances are assumptions rather than candidate provenance.

nodes.label: Runtime diet normalization and BA closure
nodes.rationale: Requested normalization rescales every nonzero diet including import, even within tolerance. Only originally production-consistent living groups with finite counterfactual terms receive opposite predation delta in runtime BA; ledger records exclusions. Empty diets are not reconstructed and this BA is not observed.
nodes.norm_label: runtime diet normalization and ba closure

nodes.label: Deterministic runtime completion
nodes.rationale: Parse numeric types/sentinels and derive flows, use missing biomass placeholder one, supply documented defaults and solve one-missing-term equations. Recomputed rates do not turn original missingness into measured data.

nodes.label: Detritus fate finalization
nodes.rationale: Absent prey pairs are structural zero; explicitly unknown consumer/import fractions fail validation. Canonical pool fate overrides embedded fate, including zero; supplied producer and detritus routing is preserved. Only genuinely absent routing gets legacy defaults. Known detritus accumulation stays source data; detritus_stock_residual separately records loaded-flow closure.

nodes.label: Rpath companion discard-return adapter
nodes.rationale: Joins discards_by_fleet to exact fleet rows and pool columns in the published companion. Complete/unavailable/incomplete routing stays explicit; missing identities are not guessed and positive unresolved discards cannot become zero returns. Fishery PPR uses source catch.

nodes.label: Source and derived trophic levels
nodes.rationale: Published TL/missing markers are retained; missing runtime TL may be derived without cycle removal. Location uses supplied identity/canonical regional path rather than a fixed default.

nodes.label: Per-group LIM completion
nodes.rationale: Optimizes missing flows with known terms, diets and predation fixed, then refreshes predation/detritus flows. Not coupled reconstruction; failed unsolved cells remain missing before explicit runtime fallbacks. Near-zero EE precision correction is separate.

nodes.label: Separate balanced_model copy
nodes.rationale: Residuals default into growth/migration in a separate copy. Exporter returns original completed calculator unless caller explicitly substitutes it.

nodes.label: EE floor calculation assumption
nodes.rationale: Once after completion, eligible real living groups with valid source EE and positive production may be raised to 0.1. Removed mortality is hypothetical external nonfishery sink; living flows/catch stay fixed. Unknown source EE stays ineligible and negative detritus residuals remain limitations.

nodes.label: Archived-loader EE-floor upgrade
nodes.rationale: Explicit ee_floor_v1 retains audited archived loader bytes while using current post-initialization accounting with both code hashes. Unknown historical flags do not imply ON; original signed diagnostics remain historical review evidence.

nodes.label: Trophic-level and flow-network methods
nodes.rationale: Classic methods use TL and uniform efficiency; network methods trace branching diets and source contributions. Outputs alone do not establish readiness or approval.

nodes.label: EE floor effective runtime state
nodes.rationale: Valid source EE is required. Effective EE includes hypothetical external mortality sink, separate in weighted budgets; living flows and fishery catch stay fixed. Changed floor restores pre-floor state first.

nodes.label: get_TE
nodes.rationale: Builds GE, TE, With Egestion or global efficiency. Global mean is arithmetic over consumers including TE zero with consumption/equal/catch/biomass weights. Fixed/group modes ignore weights.

nodes.label: get_TL
nodes.rationale: Solves recursive diet equation with explicit cycle, basal-detritus and provenance conventions.

nodes.label: get_DC and get_Z
nodes.rationale: DET_as_PP selects basal/recycling representation. Getter normalization is independent of runtime input normalization; preserving diet row sums preserves absolute flows.

nodes.label: SPPR_1986
nodes.rationale: Fixed TE 0.1 applied to one catch-weighted TL gives all groups the same coefficient; no catch gives zeros.

nodes.label: SPPR_1995
nodes.rationale: Uniform TE raised to one minus each group TL; fixed/weighted global or explicit aggregated discrete-level efficiency.

nodes.label: get_aggregated_TE
nodes.rationale: Fractionally allocates omnivore flows over discrete levels after optional cycle removal. TE=(predation+export)/(predation+export+respiration+detrital flow); model summary is geometric mean of II-IV. Missing flows propagate and invalid requested efficiencies reject.

nodes.label: Aggregated trophic efficiency sink accounting
nodes.rationale: Exports include catch, signed migration, detritus export and floor sink once. BA is not export. Project formulation differs from the 1995 pooled arithmetic summary and cited EwE display numerator.

nodes.label: Ecopath manual section 7.2
nodes.rationale: Cited for export-inclusive discrete trophic efficiency definition.

nodes.label: Pauly and Christensen 1995
nodes.rationale: Named source for classic per-group TL method; cited figure pools 140 level estimates over 48 models with arithmetic mean, distinct from per-model geometric summary.

nodes.label: SPPR_1995_TL_fix
nodes.rationale: Blends adjacent integer-level coefficients; convex exponential differs at fractional TL. This is accounting convention, not observed diet allocation.

nodes.label: Basal-source nullspace foundation
nodes.rationale: A=DC/TE gives per-edge requirement; replace basal rows with identity and RREF-normalize nullspace of A-I to source columns. Cycle-sum interpretation needs convergence.

nodes.label: SPPR_EwE
nodes.rationale: Sums products along simple paths with optional focal-row EE scaling. Repeated cycles are omitted; returning paths does not establish full cycle accounting.

nodes.label: SPPR_EwE_Ulanowicz
nodes.rationale: Deletes weakest cycle edges without renormalization then solves nullspace. It agrees with complete simple-path sum on acyclic webs but generally differs on cyclic webs.

nodes.label: SPPR_2015
nodes.rationale: Leontief inverse after detrital PP ancestry reassignment. Useful-production normalization equals DC/(GE*EE); series interpretation needs spectral radius below one.

nodes.label: SPPR_new
nodes.rationale: Numeric nullspace method retains living cycles and explicit detritus resolution. Executable detritus branch supports GE/TE/With Egestion, not global.

nodes.label: Single-pool detritus fixed point
nodes.rationale: Solve x=a+b*x as a/(1-b). GE credits mortality while egestion dilutes inflow; With Egestion assigns egested food prey SPPR. The stated TE direct-ancestry derivation omits later explicit-return coupling described in user guide.

nodes.label: Coupled detritus system
nodes.rationale: Living nullspace supplies basis columns; routed mortality and optionally diet-unmixed egestion form B,c for (I-B)x=c. This second solve closes cross-pool recycling.

nodes.label: Detritus collapse modes
nodes.rationale: never retains direct separate-pool solve and failures; auto can pool unstable/ill-conditioned systems; always pools. Pooling sacrifices resolution without guaranteeing finite/valid output.

nodes.label: Detritus openness transforms
nodes.rationale: recycling_loss multiplies B by diag(theta); source_dilution also changes c to theta*c+external_sppr*(1-theta). none changes neither. External source cost changes c, not gain B.

nodes.label: EE-zero detritus re-credit
nodes.rationale: fix_EE_0_cases re-credits burden severed by TE zero only for single-detritus TE and symbolic as_PP branch. No repair to source EE, small-positive EE or multi-pool case.

nodes.label: SPPR_symbolic
nodes.rationale: Symbolic equations retain sources; as_DC solves imported food cost from internal diet while as_PP gives it unit basal cost. Shared detritus arguments have different supported branches.

nodes.label: _build_det_BC
nodes.rationale: Assembles pool coupling and non-detrital source terms.

nodes.label: _solve_det_scaling
nodes.rationale: Applies openness, tests stability, chooses direct/pooled solve and scales detritus columns; diagnostic state precedes fallback.

nodes.label: _sample_SPPR_new_forced_balance
nodes.rationale: Solves one detritus scaling unknown to force weighted global budget including mortality sink; distinct algebraic closure operation.

nodes.label: monte_carlo_SPPR
nodes.rationale: Gamma-samples/clips positive TE, pins nonpositive entries, runs numeric/symbolic solver with guarded kwargs, and retains accepted samples/rejection counts. All rejected draws give NaN rather than fabricated mean.

nodes.label: Monte Carlo divergence screening
nodes.rationale: Negative coefficients alone incompletely screen divergence. exclude_diverged uses divergence FAIL from same diagnose_sppr solve; not every diagnostic component must pass.

nodes.label: diagnose_sppr
nodes.rationale: Grades requested SPPR_new configuration using input, living/detritus convergence and PP budget; echoes config and reports ungraded footprint. Failed solve can return no SPPR/balance/footprint; recovery diagnoses failure and invalid options raise.

nodes.label: Living and detritus convergence conditions
nodes.rationale: rho(A_LL)<1 and rho(B)<1 are distinct prerequisites. Living inverse generates detritus basis, so living failure invalidates latter interpretation. Near-one gains and extreme detritus cost warn even below one.

nodes.label: Negative basal-source columns
nodes.rationale: Count negative source columns because positive PP can conceal negative detritus in row totals. Predicted negativity is distinct from observed coefficients.

nodes.label: get_PPR
nodes.rationale: Catch-vector product with per-source SPPR returns one row; filters drop Import and optionally DET only when source matrix exists.

nodes.label: get_NPP
nodes.rationale: Sums PP group production for implemented inner-system denominator; only_inner=False is unavailable.

nodes.label: get_PPR2NPP_ratio
nodes.rationale: Inner PPR divided by PP production; budget interpretation includes catch, accumulation, signed migration and sink. Depletion can allow ratio above one; configuration/source scope matter.

nodes.label: Fixed model-weight global TE variants
nodes.rationale: SPPR_1995_TEmean and Ulanowicz_globalTEmean use total consumption; _catch use model catch with consumer-biomass fallback. Weights fixed across atlas years include consumer TE zero.

nodes.label: API defaults and audited model settings
nodes.rationale: Function defaults, exporter choices and direct-diagnostic scope differ. Actual model-specific provenance governs; publication does not authorize inventory.
nodes.norm_label: api defaults and audited model settings

nodes.label: Constructor EE floor
nodes.rationale: Default ON 0.1 applies after loading; finite non-Boolean threshold in [0,1]. Effective EE/M0 and external nonfishery sink are independent of solver flags/catch.

nodes.label: GE TE and With Egestion direct scope
nodes.rationale: Standalone diagnostics retain full returns for three formulations, actual settings and same-solve matrices. Defaults are closed separate pools; actual authorized settings override generic exporter.
nodes.norm_label: ge te and with egestion direct scope

nodes.label: Default diagnostic thresholds
nodes.rationale: Gain warning/fail 0.7/1.0; detritus warning 10; PP gap 0.01/0.05; input residual 1e-4/0.1; diet tolerance 1e-6; marginal EE 1e-3. Grades differ from exceptions/timeouts/NOT_RUN.

nodes.label: Symbolic import and EE-zero branch restrictions
nodes.rationale: Three options have as_PP/as_DC exporter variants; EE-zero correction limited to single-pool as_PP TE. Shared argument names need not imply same equations.
nodes.norm_label: symbolic import and ee-zero branch restrictions

nodes.label: Supported global efficiency methods
nodes.rationale: Classic/Ulanowicz support weighted global means; SPPR_new rejects global in executable branch and has no global_TE/weights argument.

nodes.label: Monte Carlo exporter configuration
nodes.rationale: API 1000 gamma draws, 10 percent relative SD, plus/minus 20 percent clipping; exporter 100 draws with divergence screening/diagnostics. Default timeout 180 seconds; unavailable stays missing.

nodes.label: Post-solve all inner and PP scopes
nodes.rationale: Scopes sum columns after one solve. Unattributed classic coefficient cannot yield PP-only; SPPR_2015 lacks DET source column so inner equals PP.
nodes.norm_label: post-solve all inner and pp scopes

nodes.label: Aydin2007 Gulf of Alaska full published extraction
nodes.norm_label: aydin2007 gulf of alaska full published extraction

nodes.label: Aydin et al 2007 NOAA NMFS AFSC 178
nodes.rationale: Named NOAA memorandum compares Bering Sea, Gulf of Alaska and Aleutian Islands food webs; Appendix C supplies main numbers with Appendix A and main-text/Appendix B rules.
nodes.norm_label: aydin et al 2007 noaa nmfs afsc 178

nodes.label: Gulf of Alaska 1990-1994 published model
nodes.rationale: 133 groups for 291840 square kilometres of shelf/slope at 50-1000 metres; nearshore below 50 metres excluded, LME overlap unmeasured. Distinct from later native aggregate.

nodes.label: Source-faithful partial extraction
nodes.rationale: Preserves values, zeros, trace literals and unknowns. Unpublished prey denominators/incomplete bird diets prevent full reconstruction; multi-member pools and adult-pollock routing remain unknown. Only three BA cells explicit.

nodes.label: Published diet discrepancies
nodes.rationale: Flathead sole/Southern rock sole diet totals remain 105.46/106.93 percent; allocations to absent juvenile sole stay unresolved rather than reassigned.

nodes.label: Published reconstruction readiness limits
nodes.rationale: Notes report 29 diet-sum errors, 20 warnings and conversion NOT BALANCED with 14 errors/189 indeterminate. These concern incomplete reconstruction, not authors executable model. ModelData admission is not defensible PPR readiness; no SPPR/annual PPR calculated.

nodes.label: Aydin extraction round-trip verification
nodes.rationale: Notes report 116222 cells over eight tables/thirteen companions with matching missing masks and values within 3.16e-17. Representation differences prevent literal exact equality.

nodes.label: Gulf of Alaska official Rpath aggregate
nodes.norm_label: gulf of alaska official rpath aggregate

nodes.label: Whitehouse and Aydin 2020
nodes.rationale: Assessing the sensitivity of three Alaska marine food webs to perturbations: an example of Ecosim simulations using Rpath; Ecological Modelling 429, 109074; DOI 10.1016/j.ecolmodel.2020.109074.

nodes.label: Whitehouse2020 Gulf of Alaska Rpath49 raw model
nodes.rationale: Official Ecosense.GOA at commit fe63f6d370d942ff1786f4d649e432fbfb85f81b; 46 consumers, one PP, two detritus plus fleet. Inherited 1990-1994/291840 square kilometres; distinct from 133-group extraction.
nodes.norm_label: whitehouse2020 gulf of alaska rpath49 raw model

nodes.label: Native sparse parameter preservation
nodes.rationale: Preserves literals, blanks, order, names, BA and diet NA. All 49 EE/two detritus biomasses unknown; sparse parameters are not balanced execution. Zero fate rows retained without invented exports.

nodes.label: Reversible comma-free import alias
nodes.rationale: Only strict imports use Urchins dollars cucumbers for native Urchins, dollars, cucumbers; exact canonical label/crosswalk retain identity. Representation decision is not researcher correction.

nodes.label: Native fleet detritus return fractions
nodes.rationale: Fleet fractions 0.3908825/0.6091174 retained with exact pool-name companion columns for ModelData. These differ from biological fate rows.

nodes.label: Source-to-loader missingness ledger
nodes.rationale: Notes report 490 scalar/2254 diet checks with matching diet values/masks. Only 47 blank DetInput cells become native-compatible runtime zero; source blanks, EE and detritus biomass remain unknown.

nodes.label: Candidate taxonomy pending review
nodes.rationale: Table1 visual and taxonomic-authority review pending; candidate taxonomy not applied to null canonical taxon_descr. Schema admission differs from construction, selection and approval.

nodes.label: Native reproduction follow-up
nodes.rationale: Dated notes report RDA model/diet/pedigree match CSV readers and separate native-balance variant. All three direct PPR diagnostics FAIL in current translation; neither model selected/approved by follow-up.

nodes.label: Gulf of Alaska Rpath49 native balance computational variant
nodes.norm_label: gulf of alaska rpath49 native balance computational variant

nodes.label: Whitehouse2020 Gulf of Alaska Rpath49 native balance
nodes.rationale: Separate computational variant of pinned Rpath inputs with 1990-1994/291840-square-kilometre baseline. Native-equation completion is not new observation.
nodes.norm_label: whitehouse2020 gulf of alaska rpath49 native balance

nodes.label: Native-equation parameter completion
nodes.rationale: Pinned unmodified equations solved 49 EE, two detritus biomasses, TL/GE. Explicit diet NA/DetInput-zero conventions preserve known parameters, BA, catch, names/fate without normalization or fitting.

nodes.label: Native Rpath balance verification
nodes.rationale: Notes report full rank, all EE in [0,1], living balance residual at most 5.68434e-14 and 9485 checks. RDA/CSV objects match. These are reported native verification outcomes.

nodes.label: Native variant direct PPR FAIL outcomes
nodes.rationale: GE/TE/With Egestion documented FAIL with PP gaps 100.5891/75.6690/100.4364 percent. Saved decomposition attributes gaps to two unused detritus residuals; native balance is not PPR validity. Near-zero efficiencies remain limitations.

nodes.label: Global PPR research
nodes.rationale: The root guide describes regional and central workbooks, canonical model-local evidence, saved-data views and scoped scientific workflows. Scientific values, signed review applicability, numerical readiness and administrative publication remain separate.

nodes.label: Project.xlsx
nodes.rationale: The central workbook owns editable paper/model metadata and explicit researcher review records; regional summaries, ranks, geographic chunks and shared visualization metadata are generated. It does not store taxa for anonymous common-catch cohorts or own regional selections.

nodes.label: Regional workbook
nodes.rationale: One workbook per region contains Overview, Catch, Classic PPR, selected groups/coefficients, Matching, annual PPR, NPP, ratios and diagnostics. Overview owns selection; saved arithmetic is typed values produced by Python, and blank differs from zero.

nodes.label: Workbook table contract
nodes.rationale: Tables begin with @table and a following header row. Keys are unique, literal text stays text, authoritative formulas are rejected, and blank is missing while zero is actual zero. Native Excel tables retain separate marker rows; saving Excel alone does not refresh generated values.

nodes.label: Registered researcher review
nodes.rationale: Review is per exact unit/model and derives from the signed Word source, canonical extraction and registered reviewed diagnostic prose/configuration conditions. Positive and negative decisions retain exact status/reason; additional methods or Monte Carlo do not revoke or extend the decision. This graph does not verify current signed binary state.

nodes.label: PPR Matching rows
nodes.rationale: Matching records exact model/taxon/group/weight/confidence/evidence/explanation, with one taxon/group row and weights totaling one. Unresolved rows retain the taxon and blank group/weight rather than fabricated mapping.

nodes.label: Project operating contract for agents
nodes.rationale: Current project authority defines structure, preservation, scoped execution and ownership. It separates source identity, selection, schema loading, construction, numerical readiness and explicit human approval.

nodes.label: Single canonical model.json
nodes.rationale: Each distinct regional model has exactly one canonical Ecopath model.json beside model_notes.md; source departures and unavailable provenance belong in notes. Runtime representations and administrative fields must not create a second scientific JSON authority.

nodes.label: Latest-only extraction policy
nodes.rationale: Retain only the most updated extraction per scientifically distinct model, determining lineage from identity, period, area, scenario and recorded corrections. Superseded unique evidence is removed without merging it into the latest package; losses are recorded and Git supplies recovery.

nodes.label: Overview selection authority
nodes.rationale: Regional Overview owns selected_model_id and selection_rationale. Central selected flags, paths and HTML are derived; manifests and shortcuts are not selection authorities. Review-only candidates remain selectable with unavailable values and cannot inherit the default model's results.

nodes.label: One-command regional refresh
nodes.rationale: region.py refresh derives canonical selection paths, snapshots outgoing actual result identity, restores compatible material, recalculates ready arithmetic and updates affected views. It preserves missing/FAIL/NOT_RUN/provisional semantics and performs no unrequested project-wide scientific inventory.

nodes.label: Full regional workbook snapshot
nodes.rationale: Save complete outgoing workbook bytes under actual results_model_id, retaining both incoming selection and outgoing result identity. Keep one useful snapshot per model and actual or explicitly unknown flags/code/dependency provenance; a pending empty state cannot overwrite useful results.

nodes.label: Selective compatible restoration
nodes.rationale: Restore only explicitly compatible model-dependent groups, coefficients, matching and diagnostics while retaining current independent inputs and human entries. Unknown model/code/flags prevent numerical reuse. Technical failure rolls back coherently; missing prerequisites retain selection with an exact pending reason.

nodes.label: Verified graph source freshness
nodes.rationale: One canonical knowledge graph indexes the scope of its evidence. Unchanged hash-eligible sources can be reused, whereas changed or relocated concepts need current verification. An old graph, partial trial or historical record is not present scientific approval.

nodes.label: Working with a region
nodes.rationale: The human workflow separates saved selection, narrow table inspection, regional arithmetic, scientific registration/review and read-only viewing. Publication reuses compatible saved data within requested scope; a full-project scientific inventory requires an explicit request.

nodes.label: Researcher-accepted scientific parameter preservation

nodes.rationale: The notes record Ido Carmel's 14 November 2026 authorization for normalized feeding diets and final production-balance BA. Original diet/missing BA source cells remain intact; negative residuals are computational closure, not observed stock changes. Recorded execution changed 99 diet cells and completed all 32 living BA entries, including 13 negative.
nodes.norm_label: visayan authorized runtime normalization and ba

nodes.label: Visayan Seabirds nonfishery mortality sink
nodes.rationale: For source Seabirds EE0.02, the authorized variant uses eligibility threshold0.1 and replacement EE1.0 for this group only, exporting its completed M0 while retaining egestion's detritus route. It retains the trophic compartment and matrices; the report removal is an initial display exclusion, not deletion or weight redistribution.

nodes.label: Visayan November diagnostic outcomes
nodes.rationale: The current notes report GE,TE,Egestion OK with strict balances true, no negative/nonfinite basal coefficients and inflow2570.715 matched within1e-12. Historical unnormalized WARN is separate. The notes assign Project/map/trend registration/publication to the coordinator; this textual index does not verify the signed binary or current registration.

nodes.label: Visayan fixed regional mapping assumptions
nodes.rationale: All250 regional labels retain reviewed mapping; later surveys support membership rather than measured1997 stage mass. Applying fixed1997 coefficients and proxies across the LME/later years remains assumed, and the2018 endpoint stays unselected/NOT_RUN.

nodes.label: Watari November seabird accounting scenario
nodes.rationale: The notes record authorization for floor0.1, seabird group3 M0 and egestion export, final-flow completion of missing living BA and formulation-specific external-export accounting. Source inputs and known BA remain protected;18 changed BA entries are closure terms, and the seabird biomass/rate discrepancy is deferred.

nodes.label: Watari November diagnostic review result
nodes.rationale: The new scenario's recorded GE OK, TE WARN for toothed-whale low efficiency and Egestion OK pass strict production-required balance with no negative basal contributions. These are review-only findings, separate from historical results; notes explicitly state no regional workbook, selection, Project or map/trend update.

nodes.label: Validation operation router
nodes.rationale: The skill routes explanation, wording, signed review, targeted mapping, floor evidence and full validation to needed references. A full review retains all catch taxa, full GE/TE pairing evidence, component confidence and rendered artifacts; composed validation consumes the shared mapping once.

nodes.label: Full validation scope
nodes.rationale: Ordinary validation authorizes saved evidence review, source checking, report arithmetic and artifacts, not extraction/SPPR, changed mapping/TLs, selection or publication. Missing evidence can justify a concrete minimal-run recommendation; already authorized execution remains within its stated scope.

nodes.label: Researcher-authored report preservation
nodes.rationale: Use the existing template, model-local report/appendix and full rendering workflow for Word edits. Preserve text, cells, breaks, signatures, deletions, local links, exclusions and active application sessions.

nodes.label: Signed-review bounded publication gate
nodes.rationale: Take a current pre-registration Project snapshot, register the exact source decision and verify targeted decompressed parts and old page fingerprint before publishing exact pairs. A stale page or unrelated change stops the handoff; a broad build is not a workaround.

nodes.label: Signed-review confidence table transfer
nodes.rationale: Validated transfer reads only the introduction and Overall confidence table in document order, checks two significant digits with percent signs and preserves exact Word values. The reviewed year/basis remains fixed; disqualification transfers no confidence table.

nodes.label: Exact candidate review identity
nodes.rationale: Review identity uses Selected/Candidate model and actual result identity, not an incoming default in a snapshot. Nondefault source-only disqualification binds its own signed/model hashes and cannot borrow default coefficients, mapping or exclusions.

nodes.label: Paper-to-PPR operation routes
nodes.rationale: The pipeline routes requested subsets across explanation, selection, arithmetic, extraction, mapping, diagnostics, floor migration and registry publication. Scientific-stage references remain conditional, and full-pipeline claims require completing every authorized applicable stage.

nodes.label: Pipeline scientific preservation boundaries
nodes.rationale: Keep canonical values, identities, missingness, restrictions and human edits. Extractions do not authorize selection/repair; retained compatible data and draws survive scoped publication. Floor-enabled transformations retain independent status and never inherit signed approval.

nodes.label: Audited direct-diagnostic execution
nodes.rationale: Use exact source/variant, effective constructor settings and code identity; runtime diet normalization may be recorded on a separate copy without changing canonical cells. Handle each requested method independently, save full direct returns and coefficients from one call when possible, and keep interpretation separate.

nodes.label: Diagnostic subset preservation
nodes.rationale: A narrow diagnostic request or missing-method coverage extension preserves all compatible saved methods outside scope. A schema or evidence gap does not authorize replacing reviewed results or Monte Carlo draws.

nodes.label: EE-floor eligibility and idempotence
nodes.rationale: Constructors default ON0.1, threshold must be finite0..1 even OFF, and same-state application is a no-op while changed settings restore pre-floor state. Eligibility requires valid source and completed EE plus positive production/nonnegative M0; missing/invalid source values and detritus/import/nonfeeding groups are excluded.

nodes.label: EE-floor source completed effective ledger
nodes.rationale: For eligible groups effective EE is max(pre-floor EE, threshold), effective M0=P(1-EE), and exported mortality is the removed completed M0. Preserve biological flows/catch and distinguish source, completed and effective values, including unknown raw M0.

nodes.label: EE-floor migration dependency scope
nodes.rationale: Filter exact requested units/pairs before adapters/backups, persist flags and audited settings, and rerun only changed numerical dependencies within authorization. Preserve unaffected methods and metadata-only draws; all-method requests use the canonical registry rather than a narrower report list.

nodes.label: EE-floor archived engine upgrade
nodes.rationale: An explicit calculation_engine_upgrade=ee_floor_v1 retains original archived loader bytes then applies current accounting after audited initialization, recording both identities. Missing historical flags remain unknown; unsupported pinned ON rejects rather than silently relabeling old results.

nodes.label: Portable evidence completeness index
nodes.rationale: A versioned index records exact identities, method options, relative artifact paths/hashes and present/missing/failed/inapplicable availability. Reopen present artifacts and verify applicable roles/reconciliation before handoff; the checker does not choose scientific scope or prove reconciliation truth.

nodes.label: Scientific source and geographic evidence
nodes.rationale: Retain source versions/cell locators, modeled/catch periods, study and boundary identities, and both overlap denominators A=overlap/region and B=overlap/study. Ordered coast traces need source/control-point checks, not just polygon validity and land clipping.

nodes.label: Zero catch with unknown coefficient
nodes.rationale: A missing coefficient remains missing even when recorded catch is zero; that year's genuine zero-catch contribution is zero. Positive catch with unknown coefficient has unknown PPR, so coefficient and annual-contribution availability masks differ.

nodes.label: Membership and allocation evidence separation
nodes.rationale: Record candidate membership and weight confidence/evidence independently, preserve all zero/rejected attempts, assumptions and actual raw/effective fields. Complete model catch then complete biomass supply Medium assumed proxies; ecological applicability is not established by numerically valid weights.

nodes.label: Review-to-adoption alignment gate
nodes.rationale: Reports and appendices must reconcile with adopted keyed regional rows, correct independent simple-chain denominators and actual rendered map controls after authorized integration. Pending proposals remain pending-alignment drafts; confidence and numerical changes are distinguished.

nodes.label: Dependency-specific safe reuse
nodes.rationale: Changed selection, confidence, mapping, model/settings, floor, catch or NPP affect different dependencies. Check content rather than timestamps, preserve unaffected results and keep signed-review applicability separate from broad numerical fingerprints.

nodes.label: Truthful workflow completion and efficiency
nodes.rationale: Report independently extracted/reviewed, reused, regenerated and incomplete stages separately. Efficiency requires matched traces of actual reads, parses, engine/render calls, writes/checks and time; unavailable token telemetry and partial trials must be labeled.

nodes.label: Scoped validated method coverage
nodes.rationale: No project-wide sequential inventory precedes publication. Filter exact requested units/model pairs before adapter discovery and backups; an empty scope does no adapter work. Preserve compatible coefficients, diagnostics, retained Monte Carlo and restrictions; completeness of recorded outcomes is separate from scientific eligibility.

nodes.label: ALL_METHOD_KEYS canonical inventory
nodes.rationale: An explicitly requested full inventory uses the engine registry, currently22 methods including legacy/global, six sym variants, MC_new_GE and MC_new_TE_EEfix. FAST_METHOD_KEYS and direct/report subsets do not define all methods; scalar methods retain unavailable decomposition.

nodes.label: Archived loader and retained result provenance
nodes.rationale: Use verified original archived source/settings where loader behavior differs; preserve exact compatible aggregates and honestly declare missing historical matrices/samples. Evidence-schema changes alone do not justify reruns or new unseeded draws.
nodes.norm_label: archived loader and retained result provenance

nodes.label: Canonical registry update transaction
nodes.rationale: Central updates use stable keys/current headers and recheck Project/regional hashes immediately before save. Preserve unrelated rows/backups; reconcile a newer workbook instead of overwriting it from a stale snapshot.

nodes.label: Article geometry and coverage separation
nodes.rationale: Paper/model coverage text does not update Map geography. Compare actual study overlay to source evidence, retain or replace approximate boundaries honestly, and preserve scientific region inputs and historical geometry.

nodes.label: Saved selection and browser preference reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Authorized Overview selection refreshes affected Project/map/trend/source defaults and exact readiness, but remembered browser choices/URL overrides can still select a former model. Verify visible controls while preserving unrelated preferences; exploratory dropdowns are separate from saved selection.
nodes.norm_label: saved selection and browser preference reconciliation

nodes.label: Knowledge-graph bounded refresh
nodes.rationale: Graphify indexes current source/decision reports and skills while preserving unchanged scientific evidence. Verify scope, hashes, endpoints and retrieval examples without parsing all raw binaries or promoting archived status to current authority.

nodes.label: Full-precision fixed mapping weights
nodes.rationale: Adopted Matching owns exact group weights; source CSVs are evidence only. Keep full precision and fixed years/scenario weights after biological/spatial candidates are established, and verify the full weighted coefficient.

nodes.label: Three catch bases and single carbon conversion
nodes.rationale: Preserve C=L+D where known and calculate landings, total catch and discards separately by taxon. Convert wet-equivalent PPR by nine once against tC NPP. Independent taxon-TL simple chain differs from model-group TL despite similar formulas; missing components do not become zero.
nodes.norm_label: three catch bases and single carbon conversion

nodes.label: Annual NPP support and earliest proxy
nodes.rationale: Fresh extraction does not adopt workbook values. Preserve algorithm availability, source year and status distinctions; ensemble spread is not confidence interval. Earliest mode fills only earlier missing display years as a labeled constant proxy, never canonical inputs, internal/later gaps or true zeros.
nodes.norm_label: annual npp support and earliest proxy

nodes.label: Independent simple PPR and NPP-only views
nodes.rationale: Independent catch-taxon simple PPR is not gated by missing articles/failed Ecopath models. NPP-only views remain independent of catch/model/PPR settings, including no-catch HS_018 and LME_064; scientific integration uses full hashed geometry.
nodes.norm_label: independent simple ppr and npp-only views

nodes.label: Fixed atlas LME high-seas union
nodes.rationale: atlas_lme_high_seas_union_v1 is the dissolved66-LME/18-high-seas union, excluding added EEZs and including no-catch regions. Integrate each scheduled model over the union before taking median; selected regional medians and overlapping regional sums are not equivalent. Full computation still does not establish observed satellite coverage.

nodes.label: NPP resumption and raw-byte identity
nodes.rationale: Resume only with unique matching source/configuration/code/geometry and full consumed/output identities. Real bytes, not path/mtime, establish freshness; old audit counts and metadata caches remain historical. Frozen study provenance is never rewritten to match a new run.

nodes.label: Compatible discard-routing transfer
nodes.rationale: Match exact model/method/scope/source hashes, group identities and weighted baseline. Exposure D/(L+D) reclassifies source catch under a uniform assumption. Require every positive supported taxon's scenario coefficient, fixed mapping support and only permitted adjacent interpolation without crossing missing/invalid points.

nodes.label: Discard-routing sensitivity envelope
nodes.rationale: At least two compatible named routes define a landings-only hypothetical min-max sensitivity envelope, not a confidence interval or all uncertainty. Across ecosystems sum common routes on a fixed complete cohort before extrema; unsupported regions cannot be dropped and source-model zero living harvest cannot supply responses.

nodes.label: Atomic coordinated publication
nodes.rationale: Assign one writer per output, prevent certification during replacement, preserve old complete artifacts on atomic-save failure and verify identities/skip reasons. Current commands replace historical builders; administrative work and bounded selection do not authorize global scientific reproduction.
